description: A0 seed taxonomy — atomic leaf topics for embedding shortlist + LLM classify. Parents group leaves only.

parents.name: Personal finance & lifestyle

parents.name: Infrastructure & hosting
parents.description: Cloud hosting, servers, DevOps, and platform operations for self-hosted or VPS workloads.

parents.name: Hardware & workstations
